name: autoreel-web
description: AutoReel landing page - AI Content Automation

scripts.build: vite build && vite build --ssr scripts/prerender-entry.jsx --outDir .ssr-tmp/prerender --logLevel error && node scripts/build-routes.mjs && node scripts/prerender.mjs && node scripts/build-posts.mjs && node scripts/build-docs.mjs && node scripts/build-downloads.mjs && node scripts/build-download-platforms.mjs && node scripts/build-download-tools.mjs && node scripts/build-download-use-cases.mjs && node scripts/build-reference-page.mjs
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run verify && npm run smoke && npm test
scripts.deploy: npm run check && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.autoreel-web.jsonc
scripts.deploy:index: npm run deploy && npm run indexnow
